GCC RUNTIME LIBRARY EXCEPTION

Version 3.1, 31 March 2009

Copyright (C) 2009 Free Software Foundation, Inc.

Everyone is permitted to copy and distribute verbatim copies of this
license document, but changing it is not allowed.

This GCC Runtime Library Exception ("Exception") is an additional
permission under section 7 of the GNU General Public License, version 3
("GPLv3"). It applies to a given file (the "Runtime Library") that bears
a notice placed by the copyright holder of the file stating that the file
is governed by GPLv3 along with this Exception.

When you use GCC to compile a program, GCC may combine portions of
certain GCC header files and runtime libraries with the compiled program.
The purpose of this Exception is to allow compilation of non-GPL
(including proprietary) programs to use, in this way, the header files
and runtime libraries covered by this Exception.

0. Definitions.

A file is an "Independent Module" if it either requires no Runtime
Library, or, more commonly, if it is part of no Compilation Unit of the
Runtime Library.

"Eligible Compilation Units" means the Compilation Units of the Runtime
Library, and of any file that depends solely on header files provided
as part of the Runtime Library.

"Covered Code" is source code governed by and subject to the GPLv3,
including sections 1 through 17 of GPLv3.

"Compilation Unit" is the smallest unit of source code that can be
compiled into a single object file.

1. Grant of Additional Permission.

You have permission to propagate a work of Covered Code, even if such
propagation would otherwise violate the terms of GPLv3, provided that
all the conditions in the following sections 1, 2, 3, and 4 are met.

2. Reproduced in Object Code.

The Covered Code must reproduce the above copyright notice and this
license in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the
distribution.

3. Eligibility.

The Covered Code must be compiled with a version of GCC, the GNU
Compiler Collection, that enables, by default, a language that has
signed and/or unsigned integer types that are not less than 16 bits in
width.

4. No Weakening of GCC Copyleft.

The availability of this Exception does not imply any general
presumption that third-party software is unaffected by the copyleft
requirements of the license of GCC.

---

Runtime libraries distributed:
  libstdc++.so.6   — GNU Standard C++ Library (GPLv3 + Runtime Exception)
  libgcc_s.so.1    — GCC low-level runtime (GPLv3 + Runtime Exception)
  libatomic.so.1   — GCC atomic built-ins (GPLv3 + Runtime Exception)

GCC version used: GCC 16 (Ubuntu 24.04 toolchain)
GCC project home: https://gcc.gnu.org/
